newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Light off lows after interims.
newsitem.headline: China Light off lows after interims.

text.p: Shares of China Light and Power Co Ltd pulled up from lows in early afternoon trade after it reported a 7.3 percent rise in interim profit.
"Investors were seen taking the results as an excuse to buy," said a sales dfirector at a regional brokerage.
The company shares were down HK$0.10 to HK$34.70 in early afternoon trade, up from their intraday low of HK$34.50 at midday. Volume was 1.24 million shares worth HK$43.07 million.
The utility posted a 7.3 percent rise in net profit to HK$2.64 billion from HK$2.46 billion.
"The earnings growth is more or less in line with expectations," said Sean Li, associate director at Amsteel Securities. "And we did not see much excitement in its earnings in the medium run."
Brokers said investors switching to defensive utilities stocks on fear of U.S. interest rate hikes also fueled demand for China Light.
